Package arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities

Class IheServiceStubPool

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.utilities.BaseServiceStubPool
arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities.IheServiceStubPool
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class IheServiceStubPool
extends BaseServiceStubPool
This class serves as pool for all created SOAP Services, which are needed for ELGA services. This is a subclass of BaseServiceStubPool. Therefore all needed services could be created at program start. In this service stub pool there are services for
  • searching health care providers in GDA-I
  • requesting identity assertion (IDA) of SVC
  • requesting pharmacy documents
  • requesting eMed-ID
  • canceling documents
  • requesting documents
  • writing documents
  • searching patient demographics in ZPI
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
